pages.text: Pipes can be styled without opening a screen. Use a dye to tint, a glow ink sac to make it luminous, or sneak with a block from the materials tag to give the pipe that material. A water bucket clears the style.$(br2)One click styles the whole connected line.

With dye channels enabled, pipes of different colours do not connect, so parallel lines can touch. The Channels toggle in the pipe screen lets a pipe cross channels again.$(br2)An anvil can style a stack of pipes, one material each.
